notes.title: New Hints and UI improvements – Demo Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello 🖖

I’m excited to share a new update for [b]Fix This House Demo[/b] that I’ve been working on. The past few weeks have been all about making the game even more relaxing and enjoyable, and I think you’ll love the new additions!

One of the biggest changes is the hint system. Now, if you need a little guidance, you can see a subtle silhouette of the final building, helping you visualize the finished structure. It's there to gently guide you without taking away from the fun of figuring things out.

I’ve also added a block counter, so you can easily keep track of how many blocks you’ve placed and how many are left. It’s a small addition, but it helps bring a nice sense of progress and clarity as you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/0fccf5cd76a2df6aafbaf53f1cef15a8f7a6bf3b.png[/img]
Lastly, I’ve squashed a few small visual bugs to make everything run more smoothly, so the experience should feel cleaner and more polished now.

I hope these changes make [b]Fix This House Demo[/b] even cozier and more satisfying to play! Can’t wait to hear what you think.

[i]See you at steam fest, 
Mikhail[/i] 😉

notes.title: Wettest update!
notes.notes:
Hello!
I’m thrilled to announce some exciting updates I’ve been working on for [b]Fix This House[/b]! The graphics have received a nice polish, with a new LEGO-like effect to bring a bit more charm to your building experience. I’ve also reworked several levels and added some fun, interactive elements.

You’ll now find [b]flowers[/b] on lamp posts, adding a soft, decorative touch. There’s even a bell sound when the small boat on the water is triggered—here’s a little sneak peek of it in action 🌼
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/aa1b18abb2b080f6a86833d8ec75247667bceef3.gif[/img]

For the winter map, I’ve added a [b]snowman[/b]! It brings a playful feel to the cold, snowy levels, and I hope you’ll enjoy it as much as I did creating it ☃️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/2e36d966d55996b92d8c26310aa6958274c4b839.gif[/img]

I’ve also placed [b]hydrants[/b] in the city locations. They can be activated by hitting them or simply clicking on them for a fun surprise! Check out the water burst in this clip 💦
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/9c67b582046025000d7a5521af18bfa7438cafaf.gif[/img]

I hope these little touches bring a bit of extra charm and life into the game, and I can’t wait to hear what you think!

Cheers, Mikhail 😉

notes.title: Demo update 1.0.4 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello, builders! I've been hard at work to bring you some fantastic improvements and new features for [b]Please Fix The Building[/b]. Here’s what’s new:

🎧 [b]Audio Fixes:[/b] I've resolved the inverted audio issue. Now, the sounds of construction are crisp and immersive!

🛠️ [b]Better Physics:[/b] Building has never felt smoother! Enjoy improved physics for a more realistic and satisfying experience.

❄️ [b]Reworked 5th Level:[/b] Step into a snowy paradise! The 5th level has been transformed into a winter scene, with gentle snow gradually covering all the blocks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/4726dfa8bcef364b5f038312220850f68373de11.gif[/img]

🔊 [b]Balanced Impact Sounds:[/b] I've normalized the loudness of impact sounds, ensuring a balanced and pleasant auditory experience.

🎆 [b]Celebratory Fireworks:[/b] Finish a level and be rewarded with a delightful fireworks animation. Your achievements deserve a celebration!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/907850a8e7d897722c0386525fd03cee2a77f96b.gif[/img]

I hope you enjoy these updates and enhancements. As always, your feedback is invaluable to me. Dive in, build to your heart's content, and let me know what you think!

Happy building! 🏗️
